steps.name: Locked app and separately pinned SDK, no native-source claim
Consume fixture environment only after GITHUB_ENV step boundary
Real app factory, loopback HTTP, auth/CSRF, parallel PDFs and fresh restart
Bind application-owned HTTP proof, never QA replacement
Expose bounded setup diagnostics without changing failure status
